title: R4 audit remediation: no unsound fence-equality fault attribution; concrete historical denials table in Driver Activity
description: R4 remediation on audited R3 HEAD 83f8b6a (correction BASE), vs integration BASE 07f22db. R4-F1: removed last_fence===claimFence as proof of current-cycle fault attribution — backend writeState() preserves last_result under a newer last_fence (recordDenial updates last_fence without last_result), so NO owner-scoped field authoritatively binds a fault to a claim. DENIED/FAULT now renders 'recorded fault · CODE' (exact code preserved incl. INTEGRITY_FAULT) with detail 'LATEST RECORDED FAULT — CURRENT CYCLE UNVERIFIED', flagged non-current: no active edge, never drives the headline; unknown attribution is NOT asserted as prior-cycle. last_outcome/last_fence/scheduler lease/driver lease kept as separate evidence rows. Scheduler BLOCKED_*/QUARANTINED stays the authoritative current blocker. Two R3 assertions updated only where they encoded the disproven fence-equality attribution (documented in test comments). R4-F2: typed AutoDriverDenial {at, fence, label} replacing opaque records; Driver Activity panel gains a bounded (8-row) historical denials table — exact labels, recorded order preserved, fmtTs-safe timestamps, null-safe placeholders, plain-text React rendering, neutral empty state, existing admission table untouched; inspector detail refers operators to the panel. Playwright spec #8 proves real table rendering incl. 10→8 bounding, injection-safe label text, and malformed timestamp handling. 86-scenario vitest + 8 e2e specs. Root test file remains the documented tooling exception; production scope apps/mission-control-ui/** only; zero backend/authority changes.
